info.title: FairPlay API
info.description:
FairPlay compares the hands of a poker room against the solution lookups that GTO Wizard served, and reports where the two meet in time. Send a batch of finished hands, then read the matches.

Send the access token of your application in the `Authorization` header: `Authorization: Bearer <access token>`. The guides explain how to get one.

tags.name: Batches
tags.description: Send a file of hands and read the matches.

tags.name: Players
tags.description: Read the recent lookups of one player.

post.description: Exchange the client id and the client secret of your application for an access token. Put `<client id>:<client secret>` in the `Authorization` header as HTTP Basic. The token lives for 10 hours. Ask for a new one when it expires.

401.description: The client id or the client secret is wrong.

post.description:
Send a CSV file of finished hands. The file needs a header row and the four columns `id`, `board`, `board_dealt_at` and `hand_finished_at`. A file holds at most 100000 rows.

The call answers with a task id. Keep it. You read the result with that id.

The work runs in the background. Nothing is ready when this call answers.

400.description: The file or the variant is not acceptable, or the monthly limit is reached.

value.error: Your monthly upload limit has been reached.

headers_unreadable.summary: The header row cannot be read

value.error: Missing required CSV headers: board, hand_finished_at.

too_many_rows.summary: The file holds more than 100000 rows

value.error: File has too many rows (120000). Maximum allowed is 100000.

bad_variant.summary: The variant is not one this API takes

401.description: The access token is absent, wrong or expired.

get.description:
Read the state of one batch. Ask again until `status` is `SUCCESS` or `FAILURE`.

On `SUCCESS` the answer holds `result.file_url`, a link to the result CSV. The link lives for 24 hours. Ask again for a new one.

The answer always reports your monthly record limit and how much of it you used.

parameters.name: task_id
parameters.description: The task id from the batch call.

value.error_message: The file could not be read.

401.description: The access token is absent, wrong or expired.

404.description: No batch of your application has this id.

get.summary: Read the boards of a player
get.description:
Read the most recent boards that one GTO Wizard player looked up, newest first. The player id is the `User ID` column of a result file.

This call answers with JSON. It holds the same facts as a row of the result file.

parameters.name: user_id
parameters.description: The player id from the `User ID` column of a result file.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Keep only the lookups after this moment. Write the time with its offset, for example `2026-03-22 20:34:52+00:00`, and encode it for the URL.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: How many boards to answer with, from 1 to 500.

401.description: The access token is absent, wrong or expired.

BearerAuth.description: The access token of your application, from the token call. See the Authentication guide.

BasicAuth.description: The client id and the client secret of your application. The token call takes this, and no other call does.

access_token.description: Put this in the `Authorization` header of every other call.

expires_in.description: How many seconds the token lives. 36000, which is 10 hours.

file.description: The CSV file of finished hands. A header row is necessary. The columns are `id`, `board`, `board_dealt_at` and `hand_finished_at`. A semicolon or a comma can separate them.

Variant.description: The game of every row in the file. One file holds one game.

task_id.description: Keep this. You read the result with it.

limit.description: How many records your application can send each month.

quota.description: How many records your application sent this month.

error_message.description: Why the work stopped. Only on `FAILURE`.

BatchStatus.description: `PENDING` and `STARTED` mean the work continues. `SUCCESS` means the result is ready. `FAILURE` means the work stopped, and `error_message` says why.

file_url.description: A link to the result CSV. Download it before it expires.

expires_in.description: How many seconds the link lives. 86400, which is 24 hours. Read the batch again for a new link.

last_processed_id.description: The `id` of the last row the work reached. A batch stops here when your monthly limit runs out. Send the rest of the file after the limit resets.

user_id.description: The player who made the lookup.

created_at.description: When the player made the lookup.

format.description: The game format, for example `Cash`. `CUSTOM` means the player used a tree of their own.

depth.description: The stack depth in big blinds. Empty when the solution does not name one.

stacks.description: The stack of every seat, joined by `-`.

pot.description: The pot at the point of the lookup.

ip_position.description: The seat in position, for example `BTN`.

oop_positions.description: The seats out of position, for example `["BB"]`.

actions.description: The action line of the lookup, for example `F-F-F-R2.5-F-C|X`.

error.description: What is wrong, in one sentence.
